text:
Eli K: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — the cloud provider auth outage last week exposed a gap in our fallback for model-registry write paths. Need clear owners + timelines for mitigations.
Samira P: Agree. I'll volunteer to own the short-term mitigation (token caching + retry backoff). ETA: 3 business days for a POC, 2 weeks for rollout.
Henry C: I'll take ownership of the long-term plan: dual-auth provider support and SLA negotiation with the vendor. Target Q2 milestone: design review in 10 days.
Maria L: For tracking, can we put these into a single JIRA epic and link action items from the PM? Reduces lost follow-ups.
Eli K: Yes — create EPIC INF-7822 and add the following immediate tasks: 1) Token cache w/ TTL and circuit breaker, 2) Runbook update for auth fallback, 3) Postmortem action owner audit.
Samira P: Created INF-7822 and linked tasks: INF-7823 (token cache), INF-7824 (runbook), INF-7825 (drill schedule). I'll attach the POC notes.
OpsBot: Incident playbook note: add step "switch to cached token mode" and "notify infra-team" to auth outage runbook.
Ashley G: Adding automation — we can detect >5% 401 spikes over 1m and flip a feature-flag that switches reads to read-replica-only and locks writes behind queue. I can prototype the flag in 4 days.
Henry C: Good. Also propose monthly vendor failover drills and a quarterly review of token expiry policies. Add recurring calendar invite under "Vendor Resilience" for Ops + Eng-ML.
Maria L: I'll set the recurring invite (monthly, 1hr) and add an agenda template: review metrics, test failover, update runbook.
Eli K: Action owners recap: Samira = short-term token cache (3d POC), Ashley = write-fallback feature-flag (4d prototype), Henry = dual-auth design + vendor SLA (10d design), Maria = tracking + calendar. Ops to update runbook.
Samira P: POC notes (inline): we need a small KV (Redis) cache for tokens keyed by service-account+scope, TTL = 5m, refresh jittered. Basic logic: 
```
if token_expiry < now + 30s then refresh_async()
use cached_token()
```
I'll include metrics counters: token_refresh_failures, token_cache_hits.
Henry C: For dual-auth, we need compatibility with current model-registry JWT format. I'll draft a migration plan that supports back-compat for 30 days and an automatic fallback routing table.
Eli K: Timeline check — please post daily progress updates to this thread until the short-term fixes are live. We'll reserve a canary window after rollout and monitor latency+error-rate charts.
DeployBot: Scheduled canary deploy of token-cache feature to canary cluster at 2026-09-05T03:00Z (will announce status).
Maria L: Also logging action: ensure every auth failure includes vendor-response-code + region to spot recurring regional patterns.
Ashley G: Note on recurring incidents — last three outages correlated with provider control-plane throttling in region eu-west-3. I'll add regional routing constraints to fallback logic.
Eli K: Good catch. Put that as a required acceptance test for the rollout.
Samira P: POC ready in 2 days. I'll upload results to INF-7823 and ping infra for review.
Henry C: I'll draft the SLA negotiation points and baseline MTR for vendor (we should ask for a 15-minute RTO for auth token issuance).
Eli K: Thanks all. Closing loop: we'll reconvene in 7 days for a status check. If anything slips, update the epic and mention @Eli K. :thumbsup:
